bio:
VibePrime is a teaching tool for prime numbers: run a sieve, watch the composites fall away, and see how the classic algorithms find primes and how quickly the work grows.

One page, no install. By Tront (Trent Sterling).
title: VibePrime by Tront
list:
• VibeStar: A* pathfinding visualiser with web workers and a lot of knobs.
  • Short Path: Duan-Mao and Dijkstra shortest-path algorithms visualised in JavaScript.
  • Quantum Vibes: Interactive quantum mechanics: the double-slit experiment and Feynman path integrals in the browser.
